answer: The defence here is cross-chain identity proof via Bungee: one key, one proof, and no shortcut around it. Cloning 604 keys multiplies the price 604-fold: 53756 POA locked, or 8456 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. Trust the whisper of the check, count the vault of the cost, and read the wander of the history before any answer is graded.
